About the role

Ajackus is building an AI-powered concierge platform for private members' clubs, and we are looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer to own its intelligence layer.

Members message their club on WhatsApp, under the club's own name. An AI agent replies, makes bookings, takes payments, and introduces each member to the people they would benefit from knowing, with a clear reason behind every introduction. The platform is launching with private members' clubs and will expand to sports clubs, alumni networks, hospitality groups, and online communities.

You will own the AI service and its data architecture end to end, as the senior engineer in a small, focused product team at Ajackus.




Key responsibilities

Member intelligence and matching: Design the data architecture for people and relationships, and build reason-based matching (business, investment, advice, shared interests, friendship) that explains every introduction and improves from feedback, proven by evals.
Agentic concierge: Build end-to-end WhatsApp workflows for bookings, payments, club knowledge, and escalation, with reliable rules for when the agent acts, asks for confirmation, or hands over to a person.
User journeys: Map and build journeys for members, club teams, and internal users, each with a defined state, next step, and success measure.
Multi-tenant architecture: Enable new clubs and new verticals to be set up through configuration alone, with no code changes.
Security and trust: Enforce per-club data isolation, consent tracking, full erasure, a restricted store for sensitive data, audit logs for every agent action, and defences against prompt injection and data leakage, building towards SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
Performance and cost: Measure and reduce latency and token cost per turn through model routing, caching, prompt optimisation, and batching, while protecting quality with golden datasets, CI regression gates, and drift monitoring.

4+ years building production software, with substantial hands-on time on LLM systems that take real actions
Experience designing data architecture for people and relationships: profiles, graphs, and explainable matches
Recommendation, ranking, or matching systems in production, including systems that learn from feedback
